Hello /v/StarTrek!

I'm the moderator of /v/Babylon5, and this week we have started our weekly watch-through of Babylon 5! This show was cutting edge in many ways when the pilot first aired in 1993. It is the first show with 100% realistic space physics and all CGI special effects. It started the trend of arc-based writing, since the whole show was basically written before production even began. And it's the brainchild of one of the finest story-tellers of our time, J. Michael Straczynski, who has written hundreds of television episodes, movies, and mainstream comics.

Babylon 5 is a tele-novel; as one of the first arc-based shows it is written much tighter than, say new BSG, or any other modern serialized show. The CGI is primitive, and the acting sometimes iffy, but the story and characters are unlike anything you've seen on television. Like many shows, it ramps up slowly, so join us now, or play catch up in a few months! I promise, by the time we get to season 3, you will be absolutely hooked.

Regarding my thread-title, there are lots of coincidences between B5 and DS9, here is more about that, if you are curious.

This week we are starting with the pilot film, The Gathering. So find a DVD and join us in the discussion thread before next Monday, July 13th, when we start the series with episode 1x01.

If anyone has already seen the show, and would like to give a recommendation to new viewers ITT, it would be much appreciated. Subscribe to /v/Babylon5 today, the galaxy's last, best hope for peace!
